title: Build Grave Accord and polish rooms, records, and the first run
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord is a cooperative zombie bullet-hell game with seven classes,66 executable boss identities,five modes and six maps. This draft keeps the full feature branch separate from protected main while public polish continues.

New players get a gentle Solo preset, optional Tutorial, readable item names/prices, full home artwork, mode summaries and distinct difficulty icons. Room chat keeps its fight position and gets a separate menu area; C toggles the panel, Enter starts typing, drafts/focus survive view changes, and upgrades scroll above a separate Start/Leave action row. The obsolete rankings-unavailable message is removed. Pause labels and online behavior remain unchanged at the player's request; Solo pauses.

Team records replace the former online-board placeholder. Public authorities collect actual simulation counters, store immutable results/participant history in SQLite and provide mode/difficulty/peak-size/week filters and paged reads. Exact scores and competition ties are shared by the team. Departures retain credit, survival freezes before healing, the base result banks before the secret fight, and Endless compares its last-clear tuple. Writes retry without stopping play; hosts can finish Endless during a break. Solo/test runs and client-submitted scores cannot enter these boards. Desktop LAN has its own persistent records file.

Exact logs and limits are under reviews/chat-toggle-2026-10-29/.

The preceding a0c8c56 Windows review passes all3package copies and6actual native offline/LAN/storage fixtures, including long copied paths. It predates the newer C/layout/notice changes and remains separately versioned. Earlier packages, raw evidence and preview roots are preserved.

Team boards are scoped to the selected server. Shared deployed global rankings/recovery, active mixed-progression/WAN/endurance/capacity and rendered/human/native-language/listening/device acceptance remain open. The older protocol4Site and immutable protocol13published Windows download are unchanged. No main merge, hosted deployment or contest submission is included.

Human feedback on frozen5229 confirms the C toggle and clear Start/Leave row. This is scoped UI acceptance, not whole-game/balance/device acceptance.
